fog: Some sensations are sleeps that take up all the extent of the mind like a fog, don't let us think, don't let us act, don't let us be clearly.
A fog blanketed me, a kind of deadness. I didn’t cry; crying seemed too ordinary for this moment.

Oh Portugal, today you are fog...
The Hour has come!
foggy: The dance of renewal, the dance that made the world, was always danced here at the edge of things, on the brink, on the foggy coast.

More fundamentally, I'm interested in memory because it's a filter through which we see our lives, and because it's foggy and obscure, the opportunities for self-deception are there. In the end, as a writer, I'm more interested in what people tell themselves happened rather than what actually happened.
